result.summary: Overall the layout is clean and functional, but there is one notable content/styling bug (an impossible '-100%' discount badge) and a few minor visual concerns.

issues.description: The pizza card shows a '-100%' discount badge, which would imply the food is completely free. This looks like a data/styling error and is confusing to users.
issues.suggestion: Verify the discount value from the backend; display a realistic discount (e.g., -30%) or 'Free delivery' instead, and clamp/validate discount percentages in the UI.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' (Trattoria Piccola) is cut off at the right edge with its name truncated ('Trattoria Piccol...'). This may be intentional horizontal scroll, but the truncation is abrupt.
issues.suggestion: If horizontal scrolling is intended, add a subtle edge fade or partial next card to hint at scrollability; otherwise ensure card titles fit with proper ellipsis styling.

issues.description: The notification badge dot on the bell icon has low contrast against the red dot and may be hard to perceive for color-blind users.
issues.suggestion: Add a visible count badge or ensure the indicator also has a non-color cue (e.g., shape/outline) for accessibility.

issues.description: Illustrative food images vary in style (photo-like plate vs. flat illustration), creating slight visual inconsistency across cards.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the illustration style across restaurant images for visual consistency.
